run_bbox_text_evaluator: run the BboxTextEvaluator to evaluate matched bounding boxes and text between ground truth and predicted DoclingDocuments
test_match_bboxes: test the _match_bboxes method to find corresponding bounding boxes between true and predicted documents using IoU matching
compute_bbox_text_scores: compute BLEU, F1, precision, recall, edit distance, and METEOR scores for tokenized text from matched bounding boxes
create_dataset_evaluation: create a DatasetBoxesTextEvaluation object with per-document BoxesTextEvaluation results and aggregate statistics for all metrics
build_boxes_text_evaluation: build a BoxesTextEvaluation instance with matched bboxes, tokens, and computed text similarity scores for a single document
